title: Four Words on the Face
label: ch:te-face-words
canDo: I can name my eye, ear, nose and mouth in Telugu, and say which three the family agrees on and which one Telugu's word does not obviously match.

payoff.summary: Name కన్ను, చెవి, ముక్కు and నోరు; close the loop Chapter 32 left open on కన్ను; and say why నోరు, unlike the other three, shows no visible trace of the shared vāy root Tamil, Malayalam and Kannada all carry.
